prior_runtime_failure.summary: Hosted runner shutdown signal during in-memory scan; no aggregate report; no data conclusion

diagnostic_contract.column_reconciliation: each decrypted part must exactly match manifest column list, in order, before processing rows
diagnostic_contract.timestamp_semantics: at least one timestamp_utc or timestamp_ist is required; every present timestamp representation must agree with timestamp_epoch
diagnostic_contract.signature: all manifest columns except four approved collection-provenance variance fields when present
diagnostic_contract.duplicate_policy: exact signature repeats classified separately from conflicts; conflict fields reported by name only; no source row changed
diagnostic_contract.memory_design: disk-backed SQLite keyed by SHA-256 economic key; compressed first signature stored in runner-local temporary database; only one source part is held in memory; temporary database is deleted
diagnostic_contract.progress_reporting: part/row counters only; no row-level or contract-level data
diagnostic_contract.output: aggregate counts, schema/signature hashes, conflicting column names only; no raw rows, keys, prices, labels, feature tables or decrypted source upload

required_checks: Verify exact developer commit and all six source/test/workflow blob pins
Verify exact R4 scope amendment tester decision/report blobs and scope-only flags
Run the core self-test and core regression suite on the detached developer worktree
Run diagnostic self-test and diagnostic regression suite on the detached developer worktree
Check exact-duplicate and conflicting-signature classifications, seconds/milliseconds normalization, field-name-only conflicts, and row/part-order invariance
Verify ordered manifest schema, required semantic fields, conditional timestamp representation and extra/missing/reordered header fail-closed behavior
Static-check SQLite disk-backed per-key storage, compressed signature persistence, no full unique-signature dictionary, and automatic temporary database cleanup
Verify progress callbacks report only part and aggregate row counters with no values or identifiers
Check schema/output allowlist and all no-deduplication/no-raw-output/false model and holdout flags
Static scan for network/source imports or artifact downloads in the diagnostic and test path
Verify source artifact identity/hash check runs before manifest open and encrypted-part iterator
Verify review workflow itself does not download/open/decrypt source artifact or invoke the real diagnostic
